sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: The extra title information of a title — the text inside "(single version)", "(Moonitor remix)", … — is now shown in green italics in the cells, like a credit attribute such as "background" in the Vocals column (same colour setting). The brackets stay in the normal style. Filtering, sorting and highlighting are unchanged. It can be switched off in ⚙️ Settings → ⚠️ FINDINGS → "Show extra title information in green italics".

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: New ⚠️ WARNING "Extra title information starts uppercase": a title whose trailing "(…)" or "[…]" starts with an extra title information keyword written capitalized, e.g. "(Version 1)" or "(Live)" instead of "(version 1)" / "(live)", is tinted light yellow with a ⚠️ and listed in the ⚠️ WARNING menu and the 📊 "Findings - Warning" section of every title column. Its tint has its own switch in ⚙️ Settings → ⚠️ FINDINGS.

The keywords are configurable in ⚙️ Settings → ⚠️ FINDINGS → "Extra title information keywords" (version, single, album, soundtrack, live, rehearsal, studio, radio, remix, mix, edit, demo, … by default).

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: 📊 "Title info - Extra title information" recognizes more ETI: a group ending in a lowercase keyword counts whatever it starts with ("(Moonitor remix)", "(U.S. remix)", "(7” version)", "(Watch Out for Stella club mix)"), and so does a group starting with a capitalized keyword ("(Version 1)"). Alternative titles such as "(Theme for 9 1/2 Weeks)" still do not count. Emptying the keyword list restores the old lowercase-only rule.
